Question 1
?

Which of the following is equivalent to ∫Cf(x,y,z)ds, where f(x,y,z)=x+y−z and the curve C is parametrized by r(t)=⟨t2+1,t2−1,t2⟩ for t∈[0,2]?

a
2∫02t2t2−tdt
b
2∫02(t2−t)t+1dt
c
3∫02t2t2+1dt
d
2∫02t2t+1dt
e
23∫02t3dt
